frontier: For the explicitly added order-seven integer operator U, every invariant index-N lattice has native successive-minima ratio at most sqrt(7), shortest length at least sqrt(6/7) N^(1/6), and quotient diameter at most 18 sqrt(7) floor(N^(1/6)). U is not a native Q-isometry.

A single ideal family J(N) has exact index, product, gcd/lcm and relative multiplication diamonds on the set v_p(N) divisible by ord_7(p), with p=7 unrestricted. It does not cover every integer or preserve every earlier scalar-box node.
The shape constants survive arbitrary allowed cross-prime products. Native optimal total repair costs include 43:1, 127:47, 1247:683, and 3053:1565.
Of 63 binary linear observations, exactly 14 need 8 states and 49 need 64 states for the coarsest U-safe refinement; the general projective spectrum is proved and checked at p=2,3,5,7.

Freezing a six-coordinate integer base restores divisibility but forces a persistent short vector and linearly increasing average repair costs. Fixed base two gives W(1247)=11265 and quotient diameter 1385 at 88537, versus 683 and 13 for the new family.
